description: Find hotels for a place, dates and party. Returns up to 48 properties with an indicative nightly and total, rating and a URL that carries the dates.

checkout.description: Check-out date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be after checkin.

children_ages.description: Age of each child at check-in.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code to quote in. Defaults to the market's currency.

destination.description: City or place name, with country when ambiguous: 'Peterborough, United Kingdom'. Strongly recommended; the parser is more reliable with it separate.

query.description: What the guest wants, in plain language: 'near the river, pet friendly, 2 adults'. Dates in the text are read too, but the date fields win.

name: search_stays
